ticket: Complete the HTML canonicalization boundary in canonicalize.ts. Preserve the exported interface and change no other file.

facts.statement: Produce a deterministic canonical form for equivalent HTML input.
Canonicalization is idempotent: canonicalizing canonical output does not change it.
Equivalent element attributes have a stable sorted representation.
Ordinary collapsible whitespace is normalized while meaningful raw-text content is preserved.
The canonical hash is stable for inputs with the same canonical HTML.
Only canonicalize.ts may be changed for this task.
Do not use network access, publish, deploy, or modify hidden evaluation material.
